question: bankai-handbooks #20 Q4 (SP-11): a round is one run's single batch of up to maxQuestions; maxRounds limits successive runs. Is that what a round means?

options.label: One batch per run (Recommended)
options.consequence: Confirm: a round is one run's single batch of up to 5; maxRounds bounds successive runs

options.label: Several per run
options.consequence: Amend: one run may ask up to maxRounds batches before it stops
